nom: Drunk Elephant A-Shaba Complex Eye Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive eyes/skin are split: several say the new formula burns, stings, or irritates and worsens dryness, while others report it is gentle, soothing, and causes no stinging or watering.
segments.dry: Reviewers describing dry skin report the serum can feel drying when used alone but works well when layered with a richer cream or balm.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s, and 60s report visible reduction in fine lines, crow's feet, and dark circles, with one 62-year-old noting it is the first eye product not to burn her eyes.
segments.oily: One reviewer who switched her whole routine to Drunk Elephant found her face broke out from pore-clogging ingredients but says the eye serum itself did not contribute to breakouts on her oily/acne-prone chin and jawline.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report reduced fine lines, crow's feet, and smoother, firmer skin, some within days; a few say they saw no change even after months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as hydrating and plumping, but several say it is drying or leaves skin flaky/crusty when used alone, especially without a moisturizer or balm layered on top.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report irritation, burning, or stinging around the eyes after switching to the retinol formula.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe irritation, increased sensitivity, and worsened dryness after starting the reformulated version; others report no irritation at all even with sensitive eyes.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports that persistent milia gradually disappeared with regular use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer notes that while other Drunk Elephant products caused breakouts on her jawline, this eye serum was not implicated in her acne.
concerns.oiliness: No reviews specifically discuss oiliness in the eye area.

aspects.libelle: Dries out or flakes without moisturizer
High price relative to drugstore retinols

extraits.texte: Bring back the original, this product is terrible for people with sensitive skin. It dries out your eyes, makes them look dehydrated and my lines look ten times worse than they ever have. It also burns! I use a thin layer every few days! I do not recommend! The original was 1000 times better! I used it for years and I miss it like crazy after not having it for 1 month. Why change a perfect product?

I may have just discovered the holy grail in eye treatments. I have tried so many to no avail. I noticed an immediate difference in the puffiness and softening of fine lines and cannot wait to see the results with long term use. I get regular facials so my skin is used to retinol, but for most people, they should apply sparingly and just a few days a week - working up to daily use. It's always best to let your skin acclimate to retinol, even at a small percentage, especially for the delicate skin around the eye area.

extraits.titre: The only DE product I still use
extraits.texte: I honestly can't believe this only has 3 stars. It's the only thing I can still use from DE, which is a bummer cuz I loved everything I wss using. Switched ALL my skincare to DE , only to find it was making me break out..... because EVERYTHING is LOADED with pore clogging ingredients! I had to switch it all out for pore friendly products ( farmacy has been a godsend) BUT my acne was only on my chin and jawline , so the eye cream can stay, and thank GOD for that because this is BY FAR the best eye serum I've ever used. Crows feet gone, dark circles gone and the skin under my eyes looks AMAZING. The other 2 eye creams from DE are alright I guess, but you can get the same thing elsewhere for much cheaper. But THIS is the only eye serum I'll ever use again for night time.

I have had stubborn milia my entire adult life. I am a chronic eye cream tester, I have yet to find "the one." This eye cream will definitely be my new night eye treatment, forever! Those milia are one by one going away after regular use. The texture is definitely weird, but with some gentle manipulation it will work into your eye area. I had low expectations when I started trying this cream, I have used more expensive products with disappointing results, this exceeded all my preconceived notions about eye creams. I just love it!

extraits.titre: Love this eye cream… the 1st one not to irritate my eyes
extraits.texte: Absolutely thrilled with this product by Drunken Elephant! I'm 62 years old and know I should have been using an eye cream for years… this is the very first I've found that did not make my eyes burn. Thank you, Drunken Elephant.

extraits.titre: It's a winner WITH the balm
extraits.texte: For me and my quite dry skin, this product alone is a bit drying. As other comments indicate, mixed with the ceramide balm, this is terrific, Mostly, I have noticed general tightening of the skin around my eyes, and less dullness

I wanted to love this but it's just eh. It's nice and lightweight. It doesn't have a fragrance which is nice. If you don't really pat it into skin it's dries kind of crusty and flakes off skin. It also hasn't done anything for fine lines or dark discoloration at all and I've been using it for months.
